title: Penalty and Interest Rates on Benefit Overpayment Accounts
content:
The penalty and interest figures for Benefit Overpayment Accounts are fixed per classification as follows.

| Classification | Penalty on the overpaid principal (share of principal) | Penalty may be waived | Fund credited with collected penalty | Monthly simple interest rate | Calendar days after the determination date before the first interest month begins | Interest stops for months in which a repayment plan is current |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error | 0 | No | None | 0 | 0 | No |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Employer Reporting Error | 0 | No | None | 0 | 0 | No |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Appeal Reversal | 0 | No | None | 0 | 0 | No |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error | 0 | No | None | 0 | 0 | No |
| Fraud Overpayment — First Offense | 0.15 (15 percent) | No | Unemployment Trust Fund | 0.01 (1 percent per month) | 30 | Yes |
| Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense | 0.25 (25 percent) | No | Unemployment Trust Fund | 0.01 (1 percent per month) | 30 | No |

**Interest basis, all classifications.** Interest is simple interest on the unpaid principal; it is never compounded on penalty or on interest.

**Meaning of the zero entries.** A start-day figure of 0 means that no interest is charged to the classification; a penalty share of 0 means that no penalty is assessed.

## Figures worked on hypothetical amounts

*Hypothetical:* a Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense account established with a principal of USD 2,400.00 carries a penalty of 25 percent of that principal, USD 600.00. A month for which interest runs on an unpaid principal of USD 1,800.00 carries 1 percent of it, USD 18.00.

*Hypothetical:* a Fraud Overpayment — First Offense account with the same principal carries a penalty of 15 percent, USD 360.00.
